other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: The audited gypsum calcination operation is explicitly described as an online process.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The main function of oven 5 is the thermal transformation using
a gaseous fuel; here, the calcination of natural gypsum is carried
out, which is considered important as it is an online process.

one_line: An ISO 50002 energy audit is applied on site at a Colombian non-metallic minerals SME, focusing on gypsum grinding and calcination for plaster and stucco production.
